info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Parking Reservations Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservations Status API allows users to access and retrieve the current status of parking reservations efficiently. This service is essential for businesses and developers managing parking facilities, enabling them to monitor availability, confirm bookings, and provide real-time updates to customers. Typically used by parking service providers, application developers, and customer service teams, it supports operations such as checking reservation statuses and ensuring optimal utilization of parking resources. With this API, users can enhance their applications with up-to-date reservation information and user-friendly services.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of their reservations, providing insight into any changes or updates. It is designed to assist in managing and tracking reservations efficiently.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the current status of reservations. It includes necessary details to filter or specify the reservations for which the status is being queried.

ListParkingReservationsStatusRequest.description: The request body for the GET operation concerning the status of reservations.

ListParkingReservationsStatusResponse_20.title: Reservation Status Response

status.description: Indicates the success status of the reservation operation.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the reservation.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the reservation operation.

state.description: The current state of the reservation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the reservation request, in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional message related to the reservation status.

audit.description: Information about the audit trail for the reservation operation.

ListParkingReservationsStatusResponse_20.description: This schema represents the response structure for retrieving the status of a reservation operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the reservation.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the reservation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the reservation was created automatically.

AuditInfo.description: This schema outlines the audit details for a reservation operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken by the server to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
